name: codex-plugin-claude-agent-team
description: Coordinate native Codex and external AI models for planning, implementation, and independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and review with native and cross-provider AI teams.
interface.longDescription: An experimental local plugin for coordinating native Codex models with Claude Code, Gemini via Antigravity (AGY), and Ollama. Choose separate models for planning, implementation, and independent review. Give one reviewer decision authority or require unanimous approval from a selected panel. Reuse a matching active model for planning to avoid duplicate calls.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Team to plan, delegate, review, and integrate this feature.
Choose economical implementation models and independent reviewers for this task.
Have a panel of my selected models agree on a plan and review the finished work.
